cards.example_en: The twin sisters look alike, so teachers often mix up their names.
cards.example_zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得很像，老师经常把她们的名字搞混。

cards.example_en: The little angel in the play wore white wings.
cards.example_zh: 剧里的小天使戴着一对白色的翅膀。

cards.example_en: We bake bread together on Sunday mornings at home.
cards.example_zh: 周日早上，我们在家一起烤面包。

cards.example_en: Don't bang the door; Grandpa is asleep.
cards.example_zh: 不要用力关门，爷爷在睡觉。

cards.example_en: This travel guide became a best-seller after the holiday season began.
cards.example_zh: 假期一开始，这本旅行指南就成了畅销书。

cards.example_en: I left a bookmark on the page about the Great Wall.
cards.example_zh: 我在讲长城的那一页夹了一枚书签。

cards.example_en: The downtown bookstore stays open until nine.
cards.example_zh: 市中心的书局一直营业到九点。

cards.example_en: Take the broom and sweep the dry leaves off the front steps.
cards.example_zh: 拿扫帚把前门台阶上的干叶子扫掉。

cards.example_en: When one player got hurt, the team showed real brotherhood.
cards.example_zh: 一名队员受伤时，队伍展现出了真正的兄弟情谊。

cards.example_en: Last month a local businessman donated books to our school library.
cards.example_zh: 上个月，一位本地商人给学校图书馆捐了书。

cards.example_en: An old cannon stands in the square beside the city museum.
cards.example_zh: 一门古老的大炮立在城市博物馆旁边的广场上。

cards.example_en: We paddled a canoe down the quiet river on Sunday morning.
cards.example_zh: 星期天上午，我们划着独木舟顺安静的河而下。

cards.example_en: Around the farmyard, a yellow chick followed its mother.
cards.example_zh: 在农家院子里，一只黄色的小鸡跟着妈妈。

cards.example_en: Smoke rose from the chimney of the small house by the road.
cards.example_zh: 路边那座小屋的烟囱冒出了烟。

cards.example_en: Early in the morning, the cock crowed and woke the village.
cards.example_zh: 一大早，公鸡啼叫，把村子叫醒了。

cards.example_en: The door code is written in my notebook.
cards.example_zh: 门的代码写在我的笔记本里。

cards.example_en: On cold nights I drink hot cocoa before I go to bed.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的夜晚，我睡觉前会喝一杯热可可。

cards.example_en: He played a computer game for an hour after finishing his homework.
cards.example_zh: 他做完作业后玩了一个小时电脑游戏。

cards.example_en: Each comrade on the hiking team carried water and a map.
cards.example_zh: 徒步队里的每位同志都带了水和一张地图。

cards.example_en: We will congratulate her when she wins the singing contest.
cards.example_zh: 等她赢得歌唱比赛时，我们会祝贺她。

cards.example_en: Put a cushion on the chair so Grandma can sit comfortably.
cards.example_zh: 在椅子上放个垫子，奶奶坐着才舒服。

cards.example_en: My dad packs an extra bun for me whenever there is a match.
cards.example_zh: 一有比赛，爸爸就会给我多装一个包子。

cards.example_en: When the birthday cake arrived, the children shouted with delight.
cards.example_zh: 生日蛋糕端上来时，孩子们高兴地叫了起来。

cards.example_en: We have an English dictation every Tuesday morning at school.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周二上午在学校做英语听写。

cards.example_en: Because the street lights were dim, we walked home very carefully.
cards.example_zh: 因为路灯很昏暗，我们回家时走得很小心。

cards.example_en: Set the bowls on the dining-room table before six o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 六点之前把碗摆到餐厅的桌子上。

cards.example_en: Before dark we should leave, since the park closes at dusk.
cards.example_zh: 天黑前我们应该离开，因为公园在黄昏关门。

cards.example_en: Throw the empty bottles into the dustbin beside the gate.
cards.example_zh: 把空瓶子扔进大门旁边的垃圾箱。

cards.example_en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor if your bags are heavy.
cards.example_zh: 如果行李很重，就乘电梯上五楼。

cards.example_en: Our school teaches equality so every student is treated fairly.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校教导平等，所以每个学生都得到公平对待。

cards.example_en: Staff will equip each lab group with gloves and safety glasses.
cards.example_zh: 工作人员会给每个实验小组配备手套和护目镜。

cards.example_en: Measure the exact length of the table before buying the cloth.
cards.example_zh: 买桌布之前，先量一量桌子的准确长度。

cards.example_en: After one song played everywhere, the young singer rose to fame.
cards.example_zh: 一首歌到处播放之后，这位年轻歌手出了名。

cards.example_en: Golden wheat covered the farmland all the way to the hills.
cards.example_zh: 金黄的麦子覆盖着农田，一直延伸到山边。

cards.example_en: Always fasten your seat belt before the bus leaves the stop.
cards.example_zh: 公交车离开车站前，一定要系好安全带。

cards.example_en: On Friday the office sent a fax to confirm our hotel rooms.
cards.example_zh: 星期五，办公室发了传真来确认我们的酒店房间。

cards.example_en: On Sundays, students can enter the federal museum in the capital free.
cards.example_zh: 周日，学生可以免费进入首都的联邦博物馆。

cards.example_en: We sat by the fireplace and drank tea on the snowy evening.
cards.example_zh: 下雪的晚上，我们坐在壁炉边喝茶。

cards.example_en: Would you like some fruit juice with your sandwich at lunch?
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，你想就着三明治喝点果汁吗？

cards.example_en: Warm weather quickened the growth of the beans we planted.
cards.example_zh: 暖和的天气让我们种的豆子长得更快。

cards.example_en: Before the class photo next Wednesday, I need a haircut.
cards.example_zh: 下周三拍班级合影之前，我需要理个发。

cards.example_en: After class, hardworking students stayed to finish the group project.
cards.example_zh: 下课后，勤劳的学生留下来完成小组项目。

cards.example_en: On Friday evening, our headmaster spoke to parents in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 周五晚上，我们的校长在礼堂里对家长讲话。

cards.example_en: After the spring concert, our headmistress praised the school choir.
cards.example_zh: 春季音乐会结束后，我们的女校长表扬了学校合唱队。

cards.example_en: Our headteacher greeted every student at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 我们的校长在校门口迎接每一位学生。

cards.example_en: Hey! Your book is on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 嘿！你的书掉在地上了。

cards.example_en: From our town to the city, the new highway shortens the trip.
cards.example_zh: 从我们镇上到城里，新公路缩短了路程。

cards.example_en: Many people return to their homeland during the Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 许多人在春节期间回到自己的家乡。

cards.example_en: My neighbour is a housewife who cooks lunch for her family every day.
cards.example_zh: 我的邻居是家庭主妇，每天给家人做午饭。

cards.example_en: After the long hike, hunger made us look for a small restaurant.
cards.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，饥饿让我们去找一家小餐馆。
